csv_project_name: CM-Build for Staten Island Museum Building B Snug Harbor
csv_scope_of_work: Under the CM-Build Program, this project will comprehensively renovate 25,000 SF of interior and exterior space, including Building B and its adjacent hyphens (interconnecting buildings), at the Staten Island Museum. The renovation will transform the facility into a fully operational STEAM Education Center to be operated and maintained by the Staten Island Museum. The project includes core infrastructure upgrades, with a focus on MEP systems, as well as the design, construction, and fit-out of programmatic spaces including a STEAM lab classroom, caf , and climate-controlled galleries and collection storage.
